summary: New Gloucester's Opportunity Farm tower is listed as gone; the standing Fryeburg Fairgrounds tower is a 2009 fair replica, so the relocation claim is unconfirmed.

facts.agency: Fryeburg Fair (built the replica, per the fair's profile)
facts.status_note: A 2009 replica built by the fair, per the fair's profile; FFLA's link to the Opportunity Farm tower is not confirmed.
facts.design: Replica of the Kearsarge (North) fire tower, per the fair's profile

events.note: Newspaper note names the New Gloucester fire tower attendant; the tower's site is not stated
Newspaper note says a watchman was appointed for the New Gloucester fire tower for the season
FFLA lists the Fryeburg tower as relocated from Opportunity Farm; the fair's profile does not confirm this
Built by Fryeburg Fair as a replica of the Kearsarge (North) tower, per the fair's profile
Face-lift to the replica, per the fair's profile

corrections.current: Moved from Opportunity Farm to the Fryeburg Fairgrounds.
corrections.proposed: Standing tower at the fairgrounds is a replica built by the fair in 2009; relocation from Opportunity Farm not confirmed.
corrections.why: The fair's profile describes the standing tower as a 2009 replica and does not mention Opportunity Farm or a move.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA says the Fryeburg tower was relocated from Opportunity Farm; the fair's profile says it is a replica built in 2009. Neither source settles it.

sources.title: Fryeburg Fair's Fire Tower (profile of Howard Hatch by Junia Norris)

notes_for_editor: No build date or design found for the Opportunity Farm tower. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts New Gloucester page, which this record links, never mentions Opportunity Farm. The Conway Daily Sun replica article returned HTTP 429 twice and was not read. Read budget exceeded by about two pages.
